title: See it, say it, sort it
description: Find something that doesn't belong in a Tube station. If you can do so without exiting the station, put it in its proper place (ex. trash)
rule1: You can't have placed the thing yourself.

title: Bing bong bang bong
description: Record the Big Ben chiming

title: God Save the Queen King
description: Record the changing of the guard on your phone

title: Scream of the Damned
description: Record the Tube screeching horribly

title: Loop-de-Loop
description: Starting from a Tube station, reach the same Tube station without ever leaving the Tube or retracing your steps on the Tube map
rule1: Parallel Tube lines count as the same when it comes to retracing your steps

title: The full London experience
description:
Take a selfie from the second deck of a two-story red bus containing at least one of the following landmarks or a sign with their name on it:
The Tower of London - Buckingham Palace - The Big Ben - The British Museum - Piccadilly Circus - Shakespeare's Globe - St. Paul's Cathedral - London Bridge - Regent's Park

title: Tea Time
description: Have a cuppa and some scones

title: The Harrods Effect
description: Take a picture of something sold at Harrods designed by a famous artist or the relative of a famous artist

title: Find a Banksy
description: Find a Banksy

title: The Queen's Best Friends
description: Take a picture containing at least two Corgis

title: The Tower of London is Safe
description: Take a picture containing a combination of at least six crows or ravens

title: Cypher-Spotting
description: Find at least two different post boxes with a different Royal Cypher on them

title: The Crown's Property
description: Take a picture of a swan

title: Keep Calm and...
description: Find at least three different variants of the classic "Keep Calm and..." slogan
rule1: If the slogan is found in a giftt shop, only one item per gift shop can be counted

title: Legacy of the Bard
description: Recite at least 10 lines of the "To be or not to be" monologue by memory in front of a theatre

title: Free Education
description: Take a selfie inside at least four different museums with free admission

title: London Bridge is Staying Up
description: Build a bridge using improvised materials that stays up for at least 10 seconds

title: Pub Scrawl
description: Sketch the logo of a pub and take a picture with your drawing next to the logo

title: Royal Flush
description: Find three signs, one with the word King in it, one with the word Queen, and one referencing some other noble title (Duke, Baron, Count etc.)

title: Royal Family Tree
description: Find three signs, each containing the name of a subsequent King or Queen of England

title: London Calling
description: Find a red phone box

title: Out of Spoons
description: Take a selfie in front of three Wetherspoon all within a 1km radius of each other

title: Name, Place, Animal, Drink
description:
Find three different pubs, each of which has a different thing in its name:
- A person's name
- A location
- An animal

title: Here comes a candle
description: Do one of the following: bring oranges and lemons to St Clements, bring five farthings to St Martin's, apply for a job at Old Baily, admit something you don't know at the great bell of bow

title: Paddington's Delight
description: Find a yellow raincoat, marmalade, and a leather suitcase.

title: Monopoly
description: Visit all the streets from a monopoly colour set

title: Cross the same river twice
description:
Cross the Thames twice.
You must cross the river at two different points, using two different methods of transport
rule1: You must start and end in the neighbourhood you are claiming
rule2: You may temporarily leave the neighbourhood during this challenge
rule3: The river must have a name
rule4: Acceptable methods are: walking, cycling, tram, train, bus, or boat

title: Predict the train doors
description:
Stand at the place where the train doors will open.
If any part of the train entryway is directly in front of your eyeline when the doors open, you succeed.
rule1: Only one team member may attempt this challenge at a time
rule2: You may keep attempting this challenge with new trains

title: Go one kilometre
description:
One team member must pick a random direction by spinning around with eyes closed.
Find the point exactly 1km in that direction using google maps.
Go to within 10 metres of that point.
rule1: If the point is legally or practically inaccessible, spin again

title: Try tricky train track trials
description:
Go to a metro station that has the same first letter as the first name of someone in your team.
Describe the metro station using three adjectives which start with the same letter.
rule1: You must use the team member's most commonly used name
